title: 第3章 天级风灵根与麻烦到来第4章 一只小狐狸
content_zh:
“所以，从今天开始，你我互不打扰，你做你的仙子，我种我的药田，对吧？”
韩风的眼里出现了希翼的色彩。
只要不影响我躺平，你爱干啥干啥。
然而，姜酥柔却说道，
“也不能算是互不打扰，我拿你当挡箭牌，也确实是给你添麻烦了，你努力修炼吧，等你开通灵脉后，每十天可以去找我双修一次，这样对你我的修行都有好处。
另外，如果叶龙渊找你麻烦，你也可以告诉我，我会收拾他。
这是长老给的奖励灵石，你我每人十块，全都给你了。”
姜酥柔将一个储物袋丢给了韩风，而后直接便御剑飞走了。
努力？双修？
这些词听着就好麻烦啊。
韩风拿着储物袋，叹了口气，回到了自己的药圃里，继续摆弄草药。
姜酥柔回到自己的住处后，将身边摆满了灵石，这一次，她要突破到练气期七层了。
韩风手里拿着寒冰匕首，这个匕首挺好用的，将成熟的草药割下来后，能够冰冻草药的断口，使得药力不流失。
韩风挺喜欢的。
到了晚上，韩风回到了自己的住处，这是个双人间，还住着另一个好基友王冕，但是王冕还没回来，想来是跟他的小道侣去做爱做的事情了。
韩风将匕首放到了床头，准备脱衣服睡觉的时候，忽然，一股雄浑的灵气，突兀的出现在了他的体内。
【韩风道侣姜酥柔由练气期六层突破至七层，赐福返还道侣突破增长修为的十倍。】
韩风体内的灵气不断的增长，他大惊之下，连忙盘膝坐好，按照以前学习的功法运转周天，调动灵气来修行。
不修行不行啊，这么磅礴的灵气，要是不引导，怕是要直接爆体而亡了。
很快，韩风的灵脉便被打通了，一道灵根出现在了他的丹田内，闪闪发光，极为纯净。

【韩风打通灵脉，激活灵根，为变异天级灵根，风灵根！】
韩风进入到了练气期一层。
但这还没完，他的修为，还在不断的突破中。
练气期一层，
练气期二层，
三层……
短短一个时辰之内，韩风的修为，便突破到了练气期七层巅峰。
在练气期，每一层的修为，都要比之前的更加雄厚，但是韩风获得的只是姜酥柔从练气六层突破到七层所增加的修为的十倍，而非是整个一到七层所有修为的十倍。
增长的那部分乘以十，将韩风的修为从零直接提升到了七层巅峰。
这就是……有灵气的感觉吗？
韩风感受着体内的力量，而后忽然想起来，他现在有灵气了，能够打开储物袋了。
他连忙将储物袋滴血认主，拿起储物袋，将其打开后，便看到了里面的二十块灵石。
他拿出一块灵石，想要吸收里面的灵气，却无法吸收丝毫。
看来，他果然还是一个无法修炼的废物啊，哪怕是他有了灵根。
此时，脑海中又传来了声音。
【你只是无法自己提升修为，需要靠道侣提升而提升，如今你灵气饱和，无法吸收灵气，需消耗之后才能吸收，但饱和之后依旧无法吸收。】
听到这话，韩风便明白了，他的修为境界就像是一个容器，灵气就是里面的水，水倒掉可以再装满，但是他没办法靠自己将容器扩大，装更多的水。
就在这时，外面忽然传来了一声阴恻恻的声音，
“韩师弟在家吗？”
content_en:
"So, from today on, you and I won't disturb each other. You will be your fairy and I will plant my medicine field, right?"
There was hope in Han Feng's eyes.
As long as it doesn't affect my ability to lie down, you can do whatever you like.
However, Jiang Surou said,
"It can't be said that we don't bother each other. I used you as a shield, and it did cause trouble for you. You should practice hard. After you open your spiritual veins, you can go to me for double cultivation once every ten days. This will be good for both your and my cultivation.
In addition, if Ye Longyuan troubles you, you can also tell me and I will deal with him.
This is the reward spirit stone given by the elder. You and I each have ten yuan, all of which are given to you. "
Jiang Surou threw a storage bag to Han Feng, and then flew away with her sword.
effort? Double cultivation?
These words sound so troublesome.
Han Feng took the storage bag, sighed, returned to his medicine garden, and continued to play with herbs.
After Jiang Surou returned to her residence, she was surrounded by spiritual stones. This time, she was going to break through to the seventh level of the Qi training stage.
Han Feng held an ice dagger in his hand. This dagger was very useful. After cutting mature herbs, it could freeze the fractures of the herbs so that the potency of the herbs would not be lost.
Han Feng likes it very much.
At night, Han Feng returned to his apartment, which was a double room. Another good gay friend, Wang Mian, also lived there, but Wang Mian hadn't come back yet. He probably went to have sex with his Taoist companion.
Han Feng put the dagger on the bedside and was about to take off his clothes to sleep. Suddenly, a powerful spiritual energy suddenly appeared in his body.
[Han Feng Taoist couple Jiang Surou breaks through from the sixth level to the seventh level during the Qi training period, and the blessing is returned to the Taoist couple ten times the increase in cultivation level after the breakthrough. 】
The spiritual energy in Han Feng's body continued to grow. In shock, he quickly sat cross-legged and circulated the heavens according to the exercises he had learned before, mobilizing the spiritual energy to practice.
It's impossible without cultivation. If such a majestic spiritual energy is not guided, I'm afraid it will explode and die.
Soon, Han Feng's spiritual veins were opened, and a spiritual root appeared in his dantian, sparkling and extremely pure.
[Han Feng opened up his spiritual veins and activated his spiritual roots, which turned into mutated heaven-level spiritual roots, wind spiritual roots! 】
Han Feng entered the first level of Qi training stage.
But this is not over yet, his cultivation is still making breakthroughs.
The Qi training stage is one level,
The second level of Qi training period,
Three floors...
In just one hour, Han Feng's cultivation reached the peak of the seventh level of Qi training.
During the Qi training period, each level of cultivation was stronger than the previous one, but what Han Feng gained was only ten times the increase in Jiang Surou's cultivation from the sixth level to the seventh level of Qi training, not ten times the entire cultivation level from the first to the seventh level.
The increase was multiplied by ten, which directly raised Han Feng's cultivation level from zero to the peak of the seventh level.
Is this... what it feels like to have spiritual energy?
Han Feng felt the power in his body, and then suddenly remembered that he had spiritual energy now and could open the storage bag.
He quickly identified the owner of the storage bag with blood, picked up the storage bag, opened it, and saw the twenty spiritual stones inside.
He took out a spiritual stone and tried to absorb the spiritual energy inside, but could not absorb any of it.
It seems that he is still a waste who cannot cultivate, even if he has spiritual roots.
At this time, another voice came from my mind.
[You just can't improve your cultivation by yourself. You need to rely on Taoist companions to improve. Now you are saturated with spiritual energy and cannot absorb spiritual energy. You need to consume it before you can absorb it, but you still cannot absorb it after being saturated. 】
Hearing this, Han Feng understood that his cultivation realm was like a container, and the aura was the water inside. If the water was poured out, it could be refilled, but he could not expand the container by himself to hold more water.
At this moment, a gloomy voice suddenly came from outside,
"Is Junior Brother Han at home?"
